newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-EIGHT-MAN PALMEIRAS KEEP UNBEATEN RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EIGHT-MAN PALMEIRAS KEEP UNBEATEN RECORD.

text.p: Palmeiras held on to
their unbeaten record in the Sao Paulo championship despite
having three players dismissed in Wednesday's match against Rio
Branco.
The league leaders came from behind to win 2-1 against
opponents who also had one player sent off and missed a second
half penalty.
Rio Branco took a shock fifth-minute lead when Cure beat
three defenders for an individual goal.
Palmeiras were in further trouble when Brazilian
international Djalminha was sent off five minutes before the
break for arguing with the referee.
But the scores -- and teams -- were level on the stroke of
halftime when Rio Branco's Luiz Eduardo was ordered off for
hauling down Luizao in the penalty area and Luizao equalised
from the spot.
Former Valencia striker Viola put Palmeiras ahead five
minutes into the second half with his 14th goal of the season
but Palmeiras were then forced to hang on grimly after losing
two more players.
Central defender Sandro was sent off for a second bookable
offence in the 57th minute and goalkeeper Veloso was dismissed
near the end for time-wasting, having earlier been booked.
Palmeiras, unbeaten in 14 games, lead group one of the
championship by nine points from Portuguesa. The top two teams
in the two groups qualify for the final play-off stage.
